title: Recover baselines into isolated verified output
statement: The MOD-005 responsibility shall recover baselines into isolated verified output within the exact selected scope, preserving original meaning and explicit incomplete outcomes.

what.problem: Baseline recovery orchestration and complete-result responsibility can otherwise conflate preparation with confirmed effects or hide unavailable content.
what.desired_outcome: Recover baselines into isolated verified output.

why.rationale: SR-022 requires this accountable architectural contribution; other contributions retain their own owners.

conditions: A participant requests baseline recovery orchestration and complete-result responsibility.

contexts: The selected local project state and declared retained/current material under state-control.md.

how.approach: Apply state-control.md with exact identity/scope and original interpretation, explicit custody/authority boundaries and attributable incomplete or confirmed outcomes.

how_much.scope: Baseline recovery orchestration and complete-result responsibility. No full IR003 assessment, runtime qualification, destructive adoption or operational maintenance execution is claimed.

acceptance_criteria: Select the exact retained descriptor and custody manifest, and recover all declared authoritative content, original rules and provenance without retargeting identities, allocations or judgments.
Use an owned isolated output area and reject pre-existing or active-work destinations; recovery does not authorize destructive adoption.

Compare recovered inventory, bytes and supported recorded attributes with the retained basis and preserve original interpretation; complete recovery requires zero loss or alteration within declared scope.
Report missing, damaged, unsupported, inaccessible or partially recovered scope explicitly, including lost-receipt uncertainty, without a complete recovery claim.
Exclude unretained external material and later unsaved work; failure/cancellation preserves active work and the retained baseline, with cleanup confined to owned temporary output.
constraints: Proposed Design; no implementation, executed criterion verification or satisfaction claim.

sources.basis: Define immutable baseline custody, original-meaning comparison/recovery, attributable transition preparation and dependency-safe retirement. Preserve selective retention and separate action authority, operational maintenance and actual execution; proposed Design only.
